content: The customer, Neha Chauhan, called to confirm if her home policy (HP-001234) with DCoders was cancelled and to inquire about a bill she received in the mail afterwards. The insurance agent, Neha Kapoor, confirmed the policy was cancelled and explained that the bill was generated prior to the cancellation processing. After consulting her supervisor, the agent assured the customer that the bill is waived and no further bills will be sent.

action_items: Waive the erroneous bill for policy HP-001234
